entities.summary: Stanley Girard Schlarman was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Dodge City in Kansas from 1983 to 1998 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Belleville in Illinois from 1979 to 1983.
